item.title: Russian strike near Kyiv kills 37 in one of deadliest attacks this year
item.description: The attack follows 72 hours of near-constant drone strikes across Ukraine, severely disrupting daily life.

item.title: Remembering Dolly Parton: A tribute
item.description: She once said she wasn't offended by dumb blonde jokes because she knew she wasn't dumb and also wasn't blonde. We pause to remember the beloved icon.

item.title: Images capture devastation from deadly flash floods in Nepal
item.description: Officials in Nepal report that the death toll from Wednesday's floods, which destroyed communities in Nepal and Tibet, continues to climb.

item.title: Meta's new teen restrictions could significantly impact Instagram and Facebook use
item.description: Experts and advocates welcome Meta's agreed changes for minors, including nighttime access limits and other protective measures.
